   293	
   294	    void beginRound(const std::vector<unsigned char>& clustered) {
   295	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_clustered_, clustered.data(),
   296	                              clustered.size() * sizeof(unsigned char),
   297	                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   298	    }
   299	
   300	    int chooseBatchSize(const int requested) const {
   301	        if (requested <= 0) {
   302	            return 0;
   303	        }
   304	
   305	        size_t free_bytes = 0;
   306	        size_t total_bytes = 0;
   307	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_bytes, &total_bytes));
   308	        (void)total_bytes;
   309	
   310	        // The nearest-distance matrix is the dominant allocation.  Leave
   311	        // headroom for the CUDA runtime and other rank-local allocations.
   312	        const size_t bytes_per_seed =
   313	            static_cast<size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(double)
   314	            + 2 * sizeof(int);
   315	        const size_t usable_bytes = (free_bytes / 10) * 8;
   316	        size_t possible = usable_bytes / std::max<size_t>(1, bytes_per_seed);
   317	        possible = std::max<size_t>(1, possible);
   318	        possible = std::min<size_t>(possible, INT_MAX);
   319	        return std::min(requested, static_cast<int>(possible));
   320	    }
   321	
   322	    // Evaluate all candidate clusters in one batch.  If captured_members is
   323	    // supplied, the batch is expected to contain one seed and its exact greedy
   324	    // member sequence is returned.
   325	    void runBatch(const std::vector<int>& seeds,
   326	                  const double threshold,
   327	                  std::vector<int>& cardinalities,
   328	                  std::vector<int>* captured_members = nullptr) {
   329	        const int seed_count = static_cast<int>(seeds.size());
   330	        if (seed_count == 0) {
   331	            cardinalities.clear();
   332	            return;
   333	        }
   334	
   335	        ensureCapacity(seed_count);
   336	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, seeds.data(),
   337	                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int),
   338	                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   339	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_cardinalities_, 0,
   340	                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int)));
   341	
   342	        const size_t work_items = static_cast<size_t>(seed_count)
   343	                                 * point_count_;
   344	        initializeNearestKernel<<<cudaBlockCount(work_items),
   345	                                  CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
   346	            device_points_, device_seeds_, device_clustered_, threshold,
   347	            seed_count, point_count_, device_nearest_);
   348	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   349	
   350	        if (captured_members != nullptr) {
   351	            captured_members->clear();
   352	            captured_members->push_back(seeds[0]);
   353	        }
   354	
   355	        int active = 0;
   356	        do {
   357	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_active_count_, 0, sizeof(int)));
   358	            selectNearestKernel<<<seed_count, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
   359	                device_nearest_, threshold, seed_count, point_count_,
   360	                device_selected_, device_cardinalities_,
   361	                device_active_count_);
   362	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   363	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&active, device_active_count_, sizeof(int),
   364	                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   365	
   366	            if (captured_members != nullptr && active > 0) {
   367	                int selected = -1;
   368	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&selected, device_selected_, sizeof(int),
   369	                                      cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   370	                if (selected >= 0) {
   371	                    captured_members->push_back(selected);
   372	                }
   373	            }
   374	
   375	            if (active > 0) {
   376	                updateNearestKernel<<<cudaBlockCount(work_items),
   377	                                      CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
   378	                    device_points_, device_selected_,
   379	                    threshold, seed_count, point_count_, device_nearest_);
   380	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   381	            }
   382	        } while (active > 0);
   383	
   384	        cardinalities.resize(seed_count);
   385	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(cardinalities.data(), device_cardinalities_,
   386	                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int),
   387	                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   388	
   389	        // Every candidate contains its seed even when no additional point is
   390	        // eligible, matching generateCandidateCluster exactly.
   391	        for (int& cardinality : cardinalities) {
   392	            ++cardinality;
   393	        }
   394	    }
   395	
   396	private:
   397	    void ensureCapacity(const int requested) {
   398	        if (requested <= capacity_) {
   399	            return;
   400	        }
   401	
   402	        cudaFree(device_cardinalities_);
   403	        cudaFree(device_selected_);
   404	        cudaFree(device_nearest_);
   405	        cudaFree(device_seeds_);
   406	        cudaFree(device_active_count_);
   407	        device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
   408	        device_selected_ = nullptr;
   409	        device_nearest_ = nullptr;
   410	        device_seeds_ = nullptr;
   411	        device_active_count_ = nullptr;
   412	
   413	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_seeds_),
   414	                              static_cast<size_t>(requested) * sizeof(int)));
   415	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_nearest_),
   416	                              static_cast<size_t>(requested)
   417	                              * point_count_ * sizeof(double)));
   418	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_selected_),
   419	                              static_cast<size_t>(requested) * sizeof(int)));
   420	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_cardinalities_),
   421	                              static_cast<size_t>(requested) * sizeof(int)));
   422	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_active_count_),
   423	                              sizeof(int)));
   424	        capacity_ = requested;
   425	    }
   426	
   427	    int point_count_;
   428	    int capacity_ = 0;
   429	    Point* device_points_ = nullptr;
   430	    unsigned char* device_clustered_ = nullptr;
   440	                     const int world_size,
   441	                     std::vector<int>& local_seeds) {
   442	    const int remaining = static_cast<int>(unclustered_indices.size());
   443	    const int local_count = remaining <= rank
   444	                          ? 0
   445	                          : (remaining - rank + world_size - 1) / world_size;
   446	    local_seeds.resize(local_count);
   447	
   448	    // Cyclic ownership balances variable candidate-cluster cardinalities while
   449	    // preserving ascending order within each rank for deterministic tie logic.
   450	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   451	    for (int i = 0; i < local_count; ++i) {
   452	        local_seeds[i] = unclustered_indices[rank + i * world_size];
   453	    }
   454	}
   455	
   456	bool betterCandidate(const int candidate_size,
   457	                     const int candidate_seed,
   458	                     const int current_size,
   459	                     const int current_seed) {
   460	    return candidate_size > current_size
   461	        || (candidate_size == current_size && candidate_seed < current_seed);
   462	}
   463	
   464	// Main QT clustering algorithm.  All ranks execute the same outer greedy
   465	// loop; MPI only synchronizes the globally best candidate for each round.
   466	std::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,
   467	                                  const double threshold,
   468	                                  const int rank,
   469	                                  const int world_size,
   470	                                  const int local_device) {
   471	    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
   472	    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(point_count, 0);
   473	    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices(point_count);
   474	
   475	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   476	    for (int i = 0; i < point_count; ++i) {
   477	        unclustered_indices[i] = i;
   478	    }
   479	
   480	    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;
   481	    CudaCandidateEngine cuda_engine(points, local_device);
   482	    std::vector<int> local_seeds;
   483	    std::vector<int> cardinalities;
   484	
   485	    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {
   486	        buildLocalSeeds(unclustered_indices, rank, world_size, local_seeds);
   487	        cuda_engine.beginRound(clustered);
   488	
   489	        int local_best_size = -1;
   490	        int local_best_seed = INT_MAX;
   491	        const int batch_limit = cuda_engine.chooseBatchSize(
   492	            static_cast<int>(local_seeds.size()));
   493	
   494	        for (int begin = 0; begin < static_cast<int>(local_seeds.size());
   495	             begin += batch_limit) {
   496	            const int batch_count = std::min(
   497	                batch_limit, static_cast<int>(local_seeds.size()) - begin);
   498	            std::vector<int> batch_seeds(local_seeds.begin() + begin,
   499	                                         local_seeds.begin()
   500	                                         + begin + batch_count);
   501	            cuda_engine.runBatch(batch_seeds, threshold, cardinalities);
   502	
   503	            int batch_best_size = -1;
   504	            int batch_best_seed = INT_MAX;
   505	
   506	            // The GPU computes cardinalities.  This reduction selects the
   507	            // local winner and is intentionally OpenMP-parallel as well.
   508	#pragma omp parallel
   509	            {
   510	                int thread_best_size = -1;
   511	                int thread_best_seed = INT_MAX;
   512	
   513	#pragma omp for nowait schedule(static)
   514	                for (int i = 0; i < batch_count; ++i) {
   515	                    const int seed = batch_seeds[i];
   516	                    if (betterCandidate(cardinalities[i], seed,
   517	                                        thread_best_size, thread_best_seed)) {
   518	                        thread_best_size = cardinalities[i];
   519	                        thread_best_seed = seed;
   520	                    }
   521	                }
   522	
   523	#pragma omp critical
   524	                {
   525	                    if (betterCandidate(thread_best_size, thread_best_seed,
   526	                                        batch_best_size, batch_best_seed)) {
   527	                        batch_best_size = thread_best_size;
   528	                        batch_best_seed = thread_best_seed;
   529	                    }
   530	                }
   531	            }
   532	
   533	            if (betterCandidate(batch_best_size, batch_best_seed,
   534	                                local_best_size, local_best_seed)) {
   535	                local_best_size = batch_best_size;
   536	                local_best_seed = batch_best_seed;
   537	            }
   538	        }
   539	
   540	        int global_best_size = -1;
   541	        MPI_Allreduce(&local_best_size, &global_best_size, 1, MPI_INT,
   542	                      MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   543	
   544	        const int local_tied_seed = (local_best_size == global_best_size)
   545	                                  ? local_best_seed
   546	                                  : INT_MAX;
   547	        int global_best_seed = INT_MAX;
   548	        MPI_Allreduce(&local_tied_seed, &global_best_seed, 1, MPI_INT,
   549	                      MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   550	
   551	        if (global_best_size <= 0 || global_best_seed == INT_MAX) {
   552	            break;
   553	        }
   554	
   555	        const int local_winner_rank = (local_best_seed == global_best_seed)
   556	                                    ? rank
   557	                                    : INT_MAX;
   558	        int winner_rank = INT_MAX;
   559	        MPI_Allreduce(&local_winner_rank, &winner_rank, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MIN,
   560	                      MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   561	
   562	        // Re-run only the globally selected seed to obtain its exact member
   563	        // sequence.  This avoids storing an O(number_of_seeds * N) history on
   564	        // either host or device during the much larger cardinality search.
   565	        std::vector<int> best_members;
   566	        if (rank == winner_rank) {
   567	            std::vector<int> winner_seed(1, global_best_seed);
   568	            cuda_engine.runBatch(winner_seed, threshold, cardinalities,
   569	                                 &best_members);
   570	        }
   571	
   572	        best_members.resize(global_best_size);
   573	        MPI_Bcast(best_members.data(), global_best_size, MPI_INT, winner_rank,
   574	                  MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   575	
   576	        Cluster cluster;
   577	        cluster.seed_point = global_best_seed;
   578	        cluster.members = best_members;
   579	        clusters.push_back(cluster);
   580	
   581	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   582	        for (int i = 0; i < global_best_size; ++i) {
   583	            clustered[best_members[i]] = 1;
   584	        }
   585	
   586	        std::vector<int> next_unclustered;
   587	        next_unclustered.resize(unclustered_indices.size());
   588	        int next_count = 0;
   589	        // This compaction is ordered to exactly match remove_if on the
   590	        // ascending unclustered list.  The outer loop is synchronization
   680	} // namespace
   681	
   682	int main(int argc, char** argv) {
   683	    int provided_thread_level = MPI_THREAD_SINGLE;
   684	    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided_thread_level);
   685	    if (provided_thread_level < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
   686	        std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI implementation does not provide MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED\n");
   687	        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
   688	    }
   689	
   690	    int rank = 0;
   691	    int world_size = 1;
   692	    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
   693	    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &world_size);
   694	
   695	    MPI_Comm local_communicator = MPI_COMM_NULL;
   696	    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank,
   697	                        MPI_INFO_NULL, &local_communicator);
   698	    int local_rank = 0;
   699	    MPI_Comm_rank(local_communicator, &local_rank);
   700	
   701	    int num_points = 1000;
   702	    double threshold = 2.0;
   703	    bool validate = false;
   704	    bool print_results_flag = false;
   705	
   706	    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
   707	        if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   708	            num_points = std::atoi(argv[++i]);
   709	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-t") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   710	            threshold = std::atof(argv[++i]);
   711	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
   712	            validate = true;
   713	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
   714	            print_results_flag = true;
   715	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
   716	            if (rank == 0) {
   717	                printUsage(argv[0]);
   718	            }
   719	            MPI_Comm_free(&local_communicator);
   720	            MPI_Finalize();
   721	            return 0;
   722	        } else {
   723	            if (rank == 0) {
   724	                std::printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
   725	                printUsage(argv[0]);
   726	            }
   727	            MPI_Comm_free(&local_communicator);
   728	            MPI_Finalize();
   729	            return 1;
   730	        }
   731	    }
   732	
   733	    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0
   734	        || num_points > INT_MAX / 2) {
   735	        if (rank == 0) {
   736	            std::printf("Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\n",
   737	                        num_points, threshold);
   738	        }
   739	        MPI_Comm_free(&local_communicator);
   740	        MPI_Finalize();
   741	        return 1;
   742	    }
   743	
   744	    int device_count = 0;
   745	    const cudaError_t device_query = cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count);
   746	    if (device_query != cudaSuccess || device_count <= 0) {
   747	        std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d found no usable CUDA device: %s\n",
   748	                     rank, cudaGetErrorString(device_query));
   749	        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
   750	    }
   751	    const int device = local_rank % device_count;
   752	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));
   753	
   754	    if (rank == 0) {
   755	        std::printf("QT Clustering Benchmark\n");
   756	        std::printf("Number of points: %d\n", num_points);
   757	        std::printf("Distance threshold: %.2f\n", threshold);
   758	        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   759	        std::printf("Hybrid execution: MPI ranks=%d, OpenMP threads=%d, CUDA device=%d\n",
   760	                    world_size, omp_get_max_threads(), device);
   761	    }
   762	
   763	    std::vector<Point> points(static_cast<size_t>(num_points));
   764	    if (rank == 0) {
   765	        generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);
   766	    }
   767	    MPI_Bcast(points.data(), 2 * num_points, MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   768	
   769	    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   770	    const auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
   771	    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(
   772	        points, threshold, rank, world_size, device);
   773	    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   774	    const auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
   775	
   776	    if (rank == 0) {
   777	        const auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
   778	            cluster_end - cluster_start);
   779	        std::printf("Clustering time: %ld ms\n", cluster_time.count());
   780	        std::printf("Clusters found: %zu\n", clusters.size());
   781	
   782	        int total_clustered = 0;
   783	        int max_cluster_size = 0;
   784	#pragma omp parallel for reduction(+:total_clustered) reduction(max:max_cluster_size)
   785	        for (long long i = 0; i < static_cast<long long>(clusters.size()); ++i) {
   786	            const int size = static_cast<int>(clusters[static_cast<size_t>(i)].members.size());
   787	            total_clustered += size;
   788	            max_cluster_size = std::max(max_cluster_size, size);
   789	        }
   790	
   791	        const double average_cluster_size = clusters.empty()
   792	            ? 0.0
   793	            : static_cast<double>(total_clustered) / clusters.size();
   794	        std::printf("Points clustered: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n",
   795	                    total_clustered, num_points,
   796	                    100.0 * total_clustered / num_points);
   797	        std::printf("Average cluster size: %.2f\n", average_cluster_size);
   798	        std::printf("Maximum cluster size: %d\n", max_cluster_size);
   799	
   800	        const double time_sec = std::max(
   801	            cluster_time.count() / 1000.0, std::numeric_limits<double>::min());
   802	        const double clusters_per_sec = clusters.size() / time_sec;
   803	        const double points_per_sec = num_points / time_sec;
   804	        std::printf("Performance: %.1f clusters/s, %.1f points/s\n",
   805	                    clusters_per_sec, points_per_sec);
   806	
   807	        if (print_results_flag) {
   808	            std::vector<double> membership_data;
   809	            membership_data.reserve(num_points);
   810	            std::vector<int> membership(num_points, -1);
   811	            for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {
   812	                for (const int member : clusters[c].members) {
   813	                    membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);
   814	                }
   815	            }
   816	            for (const int member : membership) {
   817	                membership_data.push_back(static_cast<double>(member));
   818	            }
   819	            print_results(membership_data, "ClusterMembership");
   820	        }
   821	
   822	        if (validate) {
   823	            const bool valid = validateClusters(clusters, points, threshold);
   824	            if (valid) {
   825	                std::printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
   826	            } else {
   827	                std::printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
   828	                MPI_Comm_free(&local_communicator);
   829	                MPI_Finalize();
   830	                return 1;
   831	            }
   832	        }
   833	    }
   834	
   835	    MPI_Comm_free(&local_communicator);
   836	    MPI_Finalize();
   837	    return 0;
   838	}

+__device__ __forceinline__ double deviceDistance(const Point& p1,

+__global__ void initializeNearestKernel(const Point* points,
+                                        const int* seeds,

+    void runBatch(const std::vector<int>& seeds,
+                  const double threshold,

+void buildLocalSeeds(const std::vector<int>& unclustered_indices,
+                     const int rank,
+                     const int world_size,
+                     std::vector<int>& local_seeds) {
+    const int remaining = static_cast<int>(unclustered_indices.size());
+    const int local_count = remaining <= rank
+                          ? 0
+                          : (remaining - rank + world_size - 1) / world_size;
+    local_seeds.resize(local_count);
+
+    // Cyclic ownership balances variable candidate-cluster cardinalities while
+    // preserving ascending order within each rank for deterministic tie logic.
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+    for (int i = 0; i < local_count; ++i) {
+        local_seeds[i] = unclustered_indices[rank + i * world_size];
+    }
 }

+    const double dy = p1.y - p2.y;
+    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
+}
+
+__global__ void initializeNearestKernel(const Point* points,
+                                        const int* seeds,
+                                        const unsigned char* clustered,
+                                        const double threshold,
+                                        const int seed_count,
+                                        const int point_count,
+                                        double* nearest) {
+    const size_t work_item = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x
+                           + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(seed_count) * point_count;
+    if (work_item >= total) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int seed_row = static_cast<int>(work_item / point_count);
+    const int candidate = static_cast<int>(work_item % point_count);
+    const int seed = seeds[seed_row];
+
+    if (candidate == seed || clustered[candidate] != 0) {
+        nearest[work_item] = DBL_MAX;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double candidate_distance = deviceDistance(points[candidate],
+                                                      points[seed]);
+    nearest[work_item] = candidate_distance < threshold
+                        ? candidate_distance
+                        : DBL_MAX;
+}
+
+// One CUDA block owns one seed row.  The explicit pair comparison preserves
+// the original serial rule: equal distances select the lowest point index.
+__global__ void selectNearestKernel(const double* nearest,
+                                    const double threshold,
+                                    const int seed_count,
+                                    const int point_count,
+                                    int* selected,
+                                    int* cardinalities,
+                                    int* active_count) {
+    __shared__ double best_distances[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+    __shared__ int best_indices[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int seed_row = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x);
+    if (seed_row >= seed_count) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    double best_distance = DBL_MAX;
+    int best_index = INT_MAX;
+    const size_t row_offset = static_cast<size_t>(seed_row) * point_count;
+
+    for (int candidate = threadIdx.x;
+         candidate < point_count;
+         candidate += blockDim.x) {
+        const double candidate_distance = nearest[row_offset + candidate];
+        if (candidate_distance < DBL_MAX && candidate_distance < threshold
+            && (candidate_distance < best_distance
+                || (candidate_distance == best_distance
+                    && candidate < best_index))) {
+            best_distance = candidate_distance;
+            best_index = candidate;
+        }
+    }
+
+    best_distances[threadIdx.x] = best_distance;
+    best_indices[threadIdx.x] = best_index;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            const double other_distance = best_distances[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            const int other_index = best_indices[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (other_distance < best_distances[threadIdx.x]
+                || (other_distance == best_distances[threadIdx.x]
+                    && other_index < best_indices[threadIdx.x])) {
+                best_distances[threadIdx.x] = other_distance;
+                best_indices[threadIdx.x] = other_index;
+            }
         }
-        
-        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best
-        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {
-            min_diameter = max_dist;
-            closest_point = candidate;
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        const int chosen = (best_indices[0] == INT_MAX)
+                         ? -1
+                         : best_indices[0];
+        selected[seed_row] = chosen;
+        if (chosen >= 0) {
+            ++cardinalities[seed_row];
+            atomicAdd(active_count, 1);
         }
     }
-    
-    return closest_point;
 }

+// Incremental diameter update.  The original implementation recomputed the
+// distance to every existing member for every candidate.  Keeping the current
+// maximum is mathematically equivalent and reduces each growth step to one
+// distance per candidate while retaining the same greedy choices.
+__global__ void updateNearestKernel(const Point* points,
+                                    const int* selected,
+                                    const double threshold,
+                                    const int seed_count,
+                                    const int point_count,
+                                    double* nearest) {
+    const size_t work_item = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x
+                           + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(seed_count) * point_count;
+    if (work_item >= total) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int seed_row = static_cast<int>(work_item / point_count);
+    const int candidate = static_cast<int>(work_item % point_count);
+    const int chosen = selected[seed_row];
+    if (chosen < 0) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t row_offset = static_cast<size_t>(seed_row) * point_count;
+    if (candidate == chosen) {
+        nearest[work_item] = DBL_MAX;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double current_distance = nearest[work_item];
+    if (current_distance == DBL_MAX || current_distance >= threshold) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double added_distance = deviceDistance(points[candidate],
+                                                 points[chosen]);
+    const double diameter = current_distance > added_distance
+                          ? current_distance
+                          : added_distance;
+    nearest[row_offset + candidate] = diameter < threshold
+                                    ? diameter
+                                    : DBL_MAX;
+}
+
+inline int cudaBlockCount(const size_t work_items) {
+    const size_t blocks = (work_items + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1)
+                        / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+    return static_cast<int>(std::max<size_t>(1, blocks));
+}

+class CudaCandidateEngine {
+public:
+    CudaCandidateEngine(const std::vector<Point>& points, const int device)
+        : point_count_(static_cast<int>(points.size())) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_points_),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(Point)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_clustered_),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(unsigned char)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points_, points.data(),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(Point),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    }
+
+    CudaCandidateEngine(const CudaCandidateEngine&) = delete;
+    CudaCandidateEngine& operator=(const CudaCandidateEngine&) = delete;
+
+    ~CudaCandidateEngine() {
+        cudaFree(device_active_count_);
+        cudaFree(device_cardinalities_);
+        cudaFree(device_selected_);
+        cudaFree(device_nearest_);
+        cudaFree(device_seeds_);
+        cudaFree(device_clustered_);
+        cudaFree(device_points_);
+    }
+
+    void beginRound(const std::vector<unsigned char>& clustered) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_clustered_, clustered.data(),
+                              clustered.size() * sizeof(unsigned char),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    }
+
+    int chooseBatchSize(const int requested) const {
+        if (requested <= 0) {
+            return 0;
+        }
+
+        size_t free_bytes = 0;
+        size_t total_bytes = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_bytes, &total_bytes));
+        (void)total_bytes;
+
+        // The nearest-distance matrix is the dominant allocation.  Leave
+        // headroom for the CUDA runtime and other rank-local allocations.
+        const size_t bytes_per_seed =
+            static_cast<size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(double)
+            + 2 * sizeof(int);
+        const size_t usable_bytes = (free_bytes / 10) * 8;
+        size_t possible = usable_bytes / std::max<size_t>(1, bytes_per_seed);
+        possible = std::max<size_t>(1, possible);
+        possible = std::min<size_t>(possible, INT_MAX);
+        return std::min(requested, static_cast<int>(possible));
+    }
+
+    // Evaluate all candidate clusters in one batch.  If captured_members is
+    // supplied, the batch is expected to contain one seed and its exact greedy
+    // member sequence is returned.
+    void runBatch(const std::vector<int>& seeds,
+                  const double threshold,
+                  std::vector<int>& cardinalities,
+                  std::vector<int>* captured_members = nullptr) {
+        const int seed_count = static_cast<int>(seeds.size());
+        if (seed_count == 0) {
+            cardinalities.clear();
+            return;
+        }
+
+        ensureCapacity(seed_count);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, seeds.data(),
+                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_cardinalities_, 0,
+                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int)));
+
+        const size_t work_items = static_cast<size_t>(seed_count)
+                                 * point_count_;
+        initializeNearestKernel<<<cudaBlockCount(work_items),
+                                  CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device_points_, device_seeds_, device_clustered_, threshold,
+            seed_count, point_count_, device_nearest_);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+        if (captured_members != nullptr) {
+            captured_members->clear();
+            captured_members->push_back(seeds[0]);
+        }
+
+        int active = 0;
+        do {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_active_count_, 0, sizeof(int)));
+            selectNearestKernel<<<seed_count, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                device_nearest_, threshold, seed_count, point_count_,
+                device_selected_, device_cardinalities_,
+                device_active_count_);
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&active, device_active_count_, sizeof(int),
+                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+            if (captured_members != nullptr && active > 0) {
+                int selected = -1;
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&selected, device_selected_, sizeof(int),
+                                      cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+                if (selected >= 0) {
+                    captured_members->push_back(selected);
+                }
+            }
+
+            if (active > 0) {
+                updateNearestKernel<<<cudaBlockCount(work_items),
+                                      CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                    device_points_, device_selected_,
+                    threshold, seed_count, point_count_, device_nearest_);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+            }
+        } while (active > 0);
+
+        cardinalities.resize(seed_count);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(cardinalities.data(), device_cardinalities_,
+                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+        // Every candidate contains its seed even when no additional point is
+        // eligible, matching generateCandidateCluster exactly.
+        for (int& cardinality : cardinalities) {
+            ++cardinality;
+        }
+    }
+
+private:
+    void ensureCapacity(const int requested) {
+        if (requested <= capacity_) {
+            return;
+        }
+
+        cudaFree(device_cardinalities_);
+        cudaFree(device_selected_);
+        cudaFree(device_nearest_);
+        cudaFree(device_seeds_);
+        cudaFree(device_active_count_);
+        device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
+        device_selected_ = nullptr;
+        device_nearest_ = nullptr;
+        device_seeds_ = nullptr;
+        device_active_count_ = nullptr;
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_seeds_),
+                              static_cast<size_t>(requested) * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_nearest_),
+                              static_cast<size_t>(requested)
+                              * point_count_ * sizeof(double)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_selected_),
+                              static_cast<size_t>(requested) * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_cardinalities_),
+                              static_cast<size_t>(requested) * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_active_count_),
+                              sizeof(int)));
+        capacity_ = requested;
     }
-    
-    // Copy members if requested
-    if (cluster_members) {
-        *cluster_members = members;

+    int point_count_;
+    int capacity_ = 0;
+    Point* device_points_ = nullptr;
+    unsigned char* device_clustered_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_seeds_ = nullptr;
+    double* device_nearest_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_selected_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_active_count_ = nullptr;
+};

+void buildLocalSeeds(const std::vector<int>& unclustered_indices,
+                     const int rank,
+                     const int world_size,

     }

+__global__ void initializeNearestKernel(const Point* points,
+                                        const int* seeds,
+                                        const unsigned char* clustered,
+                                        const double threshold,
+                                        const int seed_count,
+                                        const int point_count,
+                                        double* nearest) {
+    const size_t work_item = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x
+                           + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(seed_count) * point_count;
+    if (work_item >= total) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int seed_row = static_cast<int>(work_item / point_count);
+    const int candidate = static_cast<int>(work_item % point_count);
+    const int seed = seeds[seed_row];
+
+    if (candidate == seed || clustered[candidate] != 0) {
+        nearest[work_item] = DBL_MAX;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double candidate_distance = deviceDistance(points[candidate],
+                                                      points[seed]);
+    nearest[work_item] = candidate_distance < threshold
+                        ? candidate_distance
+                        : DBL_MAX;
+}

+// Incremental diameter update.  The original implementation recomputed the
+// distance to every existing member for every candidate.  Keeping the current
+// maximum is mathematically equivalent and reduces each growth step to one
+// distance per candidate while retaining the same greedy choices.
+__global__ void updateNearestKernel(const Point* points,
+                                    const int* selected,
+                                    const double threshold,
+                                    const int seed_count,
+                                    const int point_count,
+                                    double* nearest) {
+    const size_t work_item = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x
+                           + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(seed_count) * point_count;
+    if (work_item >= total) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int seed_row = static_cast<int>(work_item / point_count);
+    const int candidate = static_cast<int>(work_item % point_count);
+    const int chosen = selected[seed_row];
+    if (chosen < 0) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t row_offset = static_cast<size_t>(seed_row) * point_count;
+    if (candidate == chosen) {
+        nearest[work_item] = DBL_MAX;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double current_distance = nearest[work_item];
+    if (current_distance == DBL_MAX || current_distance >= threshold) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double added_distance = deviceDistance(points[candidate],
+                                                 points[chosen]);
+    const double diameter = current_distance > added_distance
+                          ? current_distance
+                          : added_distance;
+    nearest[row_offset + candidate] = diameter < threshold
+                                    ? diameter
+                                    : DBL_MAX;
+}

+inline int cudaBlockCount(const size_t work_items) {
+    const size_t blocks = (work_items + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1)
+                        / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+    return static_cast<int>(std::max<size_t>(1, blocks));
+}

+class CudaCandidateEngine {
+public:
+    CudaCandidateEngine(const std::vector<Point>& points, const int device)
+        : point_count_(static_cast<int>(points.size())) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_points_),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(Point)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_clustered_),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(unsigned char)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points_, points.data(),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(Point),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    }
+
+    CudaCandidateEngine(const CudaCandidateEngine&) = delete;
+    CudaCandidateEngine& operator=(const CudaCandidateEngine&) = delete;
+
+    ~CudaCandidateEngine() {
+        cudaFree(device_active_count_);
+        cudaFree(device_cardinalities_);
+        cudaFree(device_selected_);
+        cudaFree(device_nearest_);
+        cudaFree(device_seeds_);
+        cudaFree(device_clustered_);
+        cudaFree(device_points_);
+    }
+
+    void beginRound(const std::vector<unsigned char>& clustered) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_clustered_, clustered.data(),
+                              clustered.size() * sizeof(unsigned char),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    }
+
+    int chooseBatchSize(const int requested) const {
+        if (requested <= 0) {
+            return 0;
+        }
+
+        size_t free_bytes = 0;
+        size_t total_bytes = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_bytes, &total_bytes));
+        (void)total_bytes;
+
+        // The nearest-distance matrix is the dominant allocation.  Leave
+        // headroom for the CUDA runtime and other rank-local allocations.
+        const size_t bytes_per_seed =
+            static_cast<size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(double)
+            + 2 * sizeof(int);
+        const size_t usable_bytes = (free_bytes / 10) * 8;
+        size_t possible = usable_bytes / std::max<size_t>(1, bytes_per_seed);
+        possible = std::max<size_t>(1, possible);
+        possible = std::min<size_t>(possible, INT_MAX);
+        return std::min(requested, static_cast<int>(possible));
+    }
+
+    // Evaluate all candidate clusters in one batch.  If captured_members is
+    // supplied, the batch is expected to contain one seed and its exact greedy
+    // member sequence is returned.
+    void runBatch(const std::vector<int>& seeds,
+                  const double threshold,
+                  std::vector<int>& cardinalities,
+                  std::vector<int>* captured_members = nullptr) {
+        const int seed_count = static_cast<int>(seeds.size());
+        if (seed_count == 0) {
+            cardinalities.clear();
+            return;
+        }
+
+        ensureCapacity(seed_count);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, seeds.data(),
+                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_cardinalities_, 0,
+                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int)));
+
+        const size_t work_items = static_cast<size_t>(seed_count)
+                                 * point_count_;
+        initializeNearestKernel<<<cudaBlockCount(work_items),
+                                  CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device_points_, device_seeds_, device_clustered_, threshold,
+            seed_count, point_count_, device_nearest_);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+        if (captured_members != nullptr) {
+            captured_members->clear();
+            captured_members->push_back(seeds[0]);
+        }
+
+        int active = 0;
+        do {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_active_count_, 0, sizeof(int)));
+            selectNearestKernel<<<seed_count, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                device_nearest_, threshold, seed_count, point_count_,
+                device_selected_, device_cardinalities_,
+                device_active_count_);
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&active, device_active_count_, sizeof(int),
+                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+            if (captured_members != nullptr && active > 0) {
+                int selected = -1;
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&selected, device_selected_, sizeof(int),
+                                      cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+                if (selected >= 0) {
+                    captured_members->push_back(selected);
+                }
+            }
+
+            if (active > 0) {
+                updateNearestKernel<<<cudaBlockCount(work_items),
+                                      CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                    device_points_, device_selected_,
+                    threshold, seed_count, point_count_, device_nearest_);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+            }
+        } while (active > 0);
+
+        cardinalities.resize(seed_count);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(cardinalities.data(), device_cardinalities_,
+                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+        // Every candidate contains its seed even when no additional point is
+        // eligible, matching generateCandidateCluster exactly.
+        for (int& cardinality : cardinalities) {
+            ++cardinality;
+        }
+    }
+
+private:
+    void ensureCapacity(const int requested) {
+        if (requested <= capacity_) {
+            return;
+        }
+
+        cudaFree(device_cardinalities_);
+        cudaFree(device_selected_);
+        cudaFree(device_nearest_);
+        cudaFree(device_seeds_);
+        cudaFree(device_active_count_);
+        device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
+        device_selected_ = nullptr;
+        device_nearest_ = nullptr;
+        device_seeds_ = nullptr;
+        device_active_count_ = nullptr;
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_seeds_),
+                              static_cast<size_t>(requested) * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_nearest_),
+                              static_cast<size_t>(requested)
+                              * point_count_ * sizeof(double)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_selected_),
+                              static_cast<size_t>(requested) * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_cardinalities_),
+                              static_cast<size_t>(requested) * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_active_count_),
+                              sizeof(int)));
+        capacity_ = requested;
     }

+    int point_count_;

+    unsigned char* device_clustered_ = nullptr;

+    double* device_nearest_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_selected_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_active_count_ = nullptr;

+void buildLocalSeeds(const std::vector<int>& unclustered_indices,
+                     const int rank,
+                     const int world_size,
+                     std::vector<int>& local_seeds) {
+    const int remaining = static_cast<int>(unclustered_indices.size());

+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+    for (int i = 0; i < local_count; ++i) {
+        local_seeds[i] = unclustered_indices[rank + i * world_size];
     }

+// CUDA uses DBL_MAX as the invalid/ineligible marker.  A valid distance is
+// always strictly below the positive threshold, so this marker is unambiguous.
+__device__ __forceinline__ double deviceDistance(const Point& p1,
+                                                 const Point& p2) {
+    const double dx = p1.x - p2.x;
+    const double dy = p1.y - p2.y;

+__global__ void initializeNearestKernel(const Point* points,
+                                        const int* seeds,
+                                        const unsigned char* clustered,
+                                        const double threshold,
+                                        const int seed_count,
+                                        const int point_count,
+                                        double* nearest) {
+    const size_t work_item = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x
+                           + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(seed_count) * point_count;
+    if (work_item >= total) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int seed_row = static_cast<int>(work_item / point_count);
+    const int candidate = static_cast<int>(work_item % point_count);
+    const int seed = seeds[seed_row];
+
+    if (candidate == seed || clustered[candidate] != 0) {
+        nearest[work_item] = DBL_MAX;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double candidate_distance = deviceDistance(points[candidate],
+                                                      points[seed]);
+    nearest[work_item] = candidate_distance < threshold
+                        ? candidate_distance
+                        : DBL_MAX;
+}

+// the original serial rule: equal distances select the lowest point index.

+    __shared__ int best_indices[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int seed_row = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x);

+// Incremental diameter update.  The original implementation recomputed the
+// distance to every existing member for every candidate.  Keeping the current
+// maximum is mathematically equivalent and reduces each growth step to one
+// distance per candidate while retaining the same greedy choices.
+__global__ void updateNearestKernel(const Point* points,
+                                    const int* selected,
+                                    const double threshold,
+                                    const int seed_count,
+                                    const int point_count,
+                                    double* nearest) {
+    const size_t work_item = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x
+                           + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(seed_count) * point_count;
+    if (work_item >= total) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int seed_row = static_cast<int>(work_item / point_count);
+    const int candidate = static_cast<int>(work_item % point_count);
+    const int chosen = selected[seed_row];
+    if (chosen < 0) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t row_offset = static_cast<size_t>(seed_row) * point_count;
+    if (candidate == chosen) {
+        nearest[work_item] = DBL_MAX;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double current_distance = nearest[work_item];
+    if (current_distance == DBL_MAX || current_distance >= threshold) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double added_distance = deviceDistance(points[candidate],
+                                                 points[chosen]);
+    const double diameter = current_distance > added_distance
+                          ? current_distance
+                          : added_distance;
+    nearest[row_offset + candidate] = diameter < threshold
+                                    ? diameter
+                                    : DBL_MAX;
+}

+inline int cudaBlockCount(const size_t work_items) {
+    const size_t blocks = (work_items + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1)
+                        / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+    return static_cast<int>(std::max<size_t>(1, blocks));
+}

+class CudaCandidateEngine {
+public:
+    CudaCandidateEngine(const std::vector<Point>& points, const int device)
+        : point_count_(static_cast<int>(points.size())) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_points_),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(Point)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_clustered_),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(unsigned char)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points_, points.data(),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(Point),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    }
+
+    CudaCandidateEngine(const CudaCandidateEngine&) = delete;
+    CudaCandidateEngine& operator=(const CudaCandidateEngine&) = delete;
+
+    ~CudaCandidateEngine() {
+        cudaFree(device_active_count_);
+        cudaFree(device_cardinalities_);
+        cudaFree(device_selected_);
+        cudaFree(device_nearest_);
+        cudaFree(device_seeds_);
+        cudaFree(device_clustered_);
+        cudaFree(device_points_);
+    }
+
+    void beginRound(const std::vector<unsigned char>& clustered) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_clustered_, clustered.data(),
+                              clustered.size() * sizeof(unsigned char),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    }
+
+    int chooseBatchSize(const int requested) const {
+        if (requested <= 0) {
+            return 0;
+        }
+
+        size_t free_bytes = 0;
+        size_t total_bytes = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_bytes, &total_bytes));
+        (void)total_bytes;
+
+        // The nearest-distance matrix is the dominant allocation.  Leave
+        // headroom for the CUDA runtime and other rank-local allocations.
+        const size_t bytes_per_seed =
+            static_cast<size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(double)
+            + 2 * sizeof(int);
+        const size_t usable_bytes = (free_bytes / 10) * 8;
+        size_t possible = usable_bytes / std::max<size_t>(1, bytes_per_seed);
+        possible = std::max<size_t>(1, possible);
+        possible = std::min<size_t>(possible, INT_MAX);
+        return std::min(requested, static_cast<int>(possible));
+    }
+
+    // Evaluate all candidate clusters in one batch.  If captured_members is
+    // supplied, the batch is expected to contain one seed and its exact greedy
+    // member sequence is returned.
+    void runBatch(const std::vector<int>& seeds,
+                  const double threshold,
+                  std::vector<int>& cardinalities,
+                  std::vector<int>* captured_members = nullptr) {
+        const int seed_count = static_cast<int>(seeds.size());
+        if (seed_count == 0) {
+            cardinalities.clear();
+            return;
+        }
+
+        ensureCapacity(seed_count);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, seeds.data(),
+                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_cardinalities_, 0,
+                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int)));
+
+        const size_t work_items = static_cast<size_t>(seed_count)
+                                 * point_count_;
+        initializeNearestKernel<<<cudaBlockCount(work_items),
+                                  CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device_points_, device_seeds_, device_clustered_, threshold,
+            seed_count, point_count_, device_nearest_);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+        if (captured_members != nullptr) {
+            captured_members->clear();
+            captured_members->push_back(seeds[0]);
+        }
+
+        int active = 0;
+        do {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_active_count_, 0, sizeof(int)));
+            selectNearestKernel<<<seed_count, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                device_nearest_, threshold, seed_count, point_count_,
+                device_selected_, device_cardinalities_,
+                device_active_count_);
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&active, device_active_count_, sizeof(int),
+                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+            if (captured_members != nullptr && active > 0) {
+                int selected = -1;
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&selected, device_selected_, sizeof(int),
+                                      cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+                if (selected >= 0) {
+                    captured_members->push_back(selected);
+                }
+            }
+
+            if (active > 0) {
+                updateNearestKernel<<<cudaBlockCount(work_items),
+                                      CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                    device_points_, device_selected_,
+                    threshold, seed_count, point_count_, device_nearest_);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+            }
+        } while (active > 0);
+
+        cardinalities.resize(seed_count);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(cardinalities.data(), device_cardinalities_,
+                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+        // Every candidate contains its seed even when no additional point is
+        // eligible, matching generateCandidateCluster exactly.
+        for (int& cardinality : cardinalities) {
+            ++cardinality;
+        }
+    }
+
+private:
+    void ensureCapacity(const int requested) {
+        if (requested <= capacity_) {
+            return;
+        }
+
+        cudaFree(device_cardinalities_);
+        cudaFree(device_selected_);
+        cudaFree(device_nearest_);
+        cudaFree(device_seeds_);
+        cudaFree(device_active_count_);
+        device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
+        device_selected_ = nullptr;
+        device_nearest_ = nullptr;
+        device_seeds_ = nullptr;
+        device_active_count_ = nullptr;
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_seeds_),
+                              static_cast<size_t>(requested) * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_nearest_),
+                              static_cast<size_t>(requested)
+                              * point_count_ * sizeof(double)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_selected_),
+                              static_cast<size_t>(requested) * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_cardinalities_),
+                              static_cast<size_t>(requested) * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_active_count_),
+                              sizeof(int)));
+        capacity_ = requested;
     }

-    if (cluster_members) {

+    int point_count_;
+    int capacity_ = 0;
+    Point* device_points_ = nullptr;
+    unsigned char* device_clustered_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_seeds_ = nullptr;
+    double* device_nearest_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_selected_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_active_count_ = nullptr;

+void buildLocalSeeds(const std::vector<int>& unclustered_indices,
+                     const int rank,
+                     const int world_size,
+                     std::vector<int>& local_seeds) {
+    const int remaining = static_cast<int>(unclustered_indices.size());
+    const int local_count = remaining <= rank
+                          ? 0
+                          : (remaining - rank + world_size - 1) / world_size;
+    local_seeds.resize(local_count);

+    // Cyclic ownership balances variable candidate-cluster cardinalities while
+    // preserving ascending order within each rank for deterministic tie logic.
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+    for (int i = 0; i < local_count; ++i) {
+        local_seeds[i] = unclustered_indices[rank + i * world_size];
     }

+__global__ void initializeNearestKernel(const Point* points,
+                                        const int* seeds,
+                                        const unsigned char* clustered,
+                                        const double threshold,
+                                        const int seed_count,
+                                        const int point_count,
+                                        double* nearest) {
+    const size_t work_item = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x
+                           + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(seed_count) * point_count;
+    if (work_item >= total) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int seed_row = static_cast<int>(work_item / point_count);
+    const int candidate = static_cast<int>(work_item % point_count);
+    const int seed = seeds[seed_row];
+
+    if (candidate == seed || clustered[candidate] != 0) {
+        nearest[work_item] = DBL_MAX;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double candidate_distance = deviceDistance(points[candidate],
+                                                      points[seed]);
+    nearest[work_item] = candidate_distance < threshold
+                        ? candidate_distance
+                        : DBL_MAX;

+// One CUDA block owns one seed row.  The explicit pair comparison preserves
+// the original serial rule: equal distances select the lowest point index.
+__global__ void selectNearestKernel(const double* nearest,
+                                    const double threshold,
+                                    const int seed_count,
+                                    const int point_count,
+                                    int* selected,
+                                    int* cardinalities,
+                                    int* active_count) {
+    __shared__ double best_distances[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+    __shared__ int best_indices[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int seed_row = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x);
+    if (seed_row >= seed_count) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    double best_distance = DBL_MAX;
+    int best_index = INT_MAX;
+    const size_t row_offset = static_cast<size_t>(seed_row) * point_count;
+
+    for (int candidate = threadIdx.x;
+         candidate < point_count;
+         candidate += blockDim.x) {
+        const double candidate_distance = nearest[row_offset + candidate];
+        if (candidate_distance < DBL_MAX && candidate_distance < threshold
+            && (candidate_distance < best_distance
+                || (candidate_distance == best_distance
+                    && candidate < best_index))) {
+            best_distance = candidate_distance;
+            best_index = candidate;
+        }
+    }

+    best_indices[threadIdx.x] = best_index;
+    __syncthreads();
+

+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            const double other_distance = best_distances[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            const int other_index = best_indices[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (other_distance < best_distances[threadIdx.x]
+                || (other_distance == best_distances[threadIdx.x]
+                    && other_index < best_indices[threadIdx.x])) {

+                best_indices[threadIdx.x] = other_index;

+        __syncthreads();

+// Incremental diameter update.  The original implementation recomputed the
+// distance to every existing member for every candidate.  Keeping the current
+// maximum is mathematically equivalent and reduces each growth step to one
+// distance per candidate while retaining the same greedy choices.
+__global__ void updateNearestKernel(const Point* points,
+                                    const int* selected,
+                                    const double threshold,
+                                    const int seed_count,
+                                    const int point_count,
+                                    double* nearest) {
+    const size_t work_item = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x
+                           + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(seed_count) * point_count;
+    if (work_item >= total) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int seed_row = static_cast<int>(work_item / point_count);
+    const int candidate = static_cast<int>(work_item % point_count);
+    const int chosen = selected[seed_row];
+    if (chosen < 0) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t row_offset = static_cast<size_t>(seed_row) * point_count;
+    if (candidate == chosen) {
+        nearest[work_item] = DBL_MAX;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double current_distance = nearest[work_item];
+    if (current_distance == DBL_MAX || current_distance >= threshold) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double added_distance = deviceDistance(points[candidate],
+                                                 points[chosen]);
+    const double diameter = current_distance > added_distance
+                          ? current_distance
+                          : added_distance;
+    nearest[row_offset + candidate] = diameter < threshold
+                                    ? diameter
+                                    : DBL_MAX;
+}
+
+inline int cudaBlockCount(const size_t work_items) {
+    const size_t blocks = (work_items + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1)
+                        / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+    return static_cast<int>(std::max<size_t>(1, blocks));
+}

+class CudaCandidateEngine {
+public:
+    CudaCandidateEngine(const std::vector<Point>& points, const int device)
+        : point_count_(static_cast<int>(points.size())) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_points_),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(Point)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_clustered_),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(unsigned char)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points_, points.data(),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(Point),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    }
+
+    CudaCandidateEngine(const CudaCandidateEngine&) = delete;
+    CudaCandidateEngine& operator=(const CudaCandidateEngine&) = delete;
+
+    ~CudaCandidateEngine() {
+        cudaFree(device_active_count_);
+        cudaFree(device_cardinalities_);
+        cudaFree(device_selected_);
+        cudaFree(device_nearest_);
+        cudaFree(device_seeds_);
+        cudaFree(device_clustered_);
+        cudaFree(device_points_);
+    }
+
+    void beginRound(const std::vector<unsigned char>& clustered) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_clustered_, clustered.data(),
+                              clustered.size() * sizeof(unsigned char),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    }
+
+    int chooseBatchSize(const int requested) const {
+        if (requested <= 0) {
+            return 0;
+        }
+
+        size_t free_bytes = 0;
+        size_t total_bytes = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_bytes, &total_bytes));
+        (void)total_bytes;
+
+        // The nearest-distance matrix is the dominant allocation.  Leave
+        // headroom for the CUDA runtime and other rank-local allocations.
+        const size_t bytes_per_seed =
+            static_cast<size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(double)
+            + 2 * sizeof(int);
+        const size_t usable_bytes = (free_bytes / 10) * 8;
+        size_t possible = usable_bytes / std::max<size_t>(1, bytes_per_seed);
+        possible = std::max<size_t>(1, possible);
+        possible = std::min<size_t>(possible, INT_MAX);
+        return std::min(requested, static_cast<int>(possible));
+    }
+
+    // Evaluate all candidate clusters in one batch.  If captured_members is
+    // supplied, the batch is expected to contain one seed and its exact greedy
+    // member sequence is returned.
+    void runBatch(const std::vector<int>& seeds,
+                  const double threshold,
+                  std::vector<int>& cardinalities,
+                  std::vector<int>* captured_members = nullptr) {
+        const int seed_count = static_cast<int>(seeds.size());
+        if (seed_count == 0) {
+            cardinalities.clear();
+            return;
+        }
+
+        ensureCapacity(seed_count);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, seeds.data(),
+                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_cardinalities_, 0,
+                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int)));
+
+        const size_t work_items = static_cast<size_t>(seed_count)
+                                 * point_count_;
+        initializeNearestKernel<<<cudaBlockCount(work_items),
+                                  CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device_points_, device_seeds_, device_clustered_, threshold,
+            seed_count, point_count_, device_nearest_);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+        if (captured_members != nullptr) {
+            captured_members->clear();
+            captured_members->push_back(seeds[0]);
+        }
+
+        int active = 0;
+        do {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_active_count_, 0, sizeof(int)));
+            selectNearestKernel<<<seed_count, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                device_nearest_, threshold, seed_count, point_count_,
+                device_selected_, device_cardinalities_,
+                device_active_count_);
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&active, device_active_count_, sizeof(int),
+                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+            if (captured_members != nullptr && active > 0) {
+                int selected = -1;
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&selected, device_selected_, sizeof(int),
+                                      cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+                if (selected >= 0) {
+                    captured_members->push_back(selected);
+                }
+            }
+
+            if (active > 0) {
+                updateNearestKernel<<<cudaBlockCount(work_items),
+                                      CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                    device_points_, device_selected_,
+                    threshold, seed_count, point_count_, device_nearest_);
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+            }
+        } while (active > 0);
+
+        cardinalities.resize(seed_count);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(cardinalities.data(), device_cardinalities_,
+                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+        // Every candidate contains its seed even when no additional point is
+        // eligible, matching generateCandidateCluster exactly.
+        for (int& cardinality : cardinalities) {
+            ++cardinality;
+        }
+    }
+
+private:
+    void ensureCapacity(const int requested) {
+        if (requested <= capacity_) {
+            return;
+        }
+
+        cudaFree(device_cardinalities_);
+        cudaFree(device_selected_);
+        cudaFree(device_nearest_);
+        cudaFree(device_seeds_);
+        cudaFree(device_active_count_);
+        device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
+        device_selected_ = nullptr;
+        device_nearest_ = nullptr;
+        device_seeds_ = nullptr;
+        device_active_count_ = nullptr;
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_seeds_),
+                              static_cast<size_t>(requested) * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_nearest_),
+                              static_cast<size_t>(requested)
+                              * point_count_ * sizeof(double)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_selected_),
+                              static_cast<size_t>(requested) * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_cardinalities_),
+                              static_cast<size_t>(requested) * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_active_count_),
+                              sizeof(int)));
+        capacity_ = requested;
     }
-    
-    // Copy members if requested
-    if (cluster_members) {
-        *cluster_members = members;
+
+    int point_count_;
+    int capacity_ = 0;
+    Point* device_points_ = nullptr;
+    unsigned char* device_clustered_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_seeds_ = nullptr;
+    double* device_nearest_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_selected_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_active_count_ = nullptr;
+};

+void buildLocalSeeds(const std::vector<int>& unclustered_indices,
+                     const int rank,
+                     const int world_size,
+                     std::vector<int>& local_seeds) {
+    const int remaining = static_cast<int>(unclustered_indices.size());
+    const int local_count = remaining <= rank
+                          ? 0
+                          : (remaining - rank + world_size - 1) / world_size;
+    local_seeds.resize(local_count);

+    // Cyclic ownership balances variable candidate-cluster cardinalities while
+    // preserving ascending order within each rank for deterministic tie logic.
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+    for (int i = 0; i < local_count; ++i) {
+        local_seeds[i] = unclustered_indices[rank + i * world_size];
     }

+                     const int current_size,
+                     const int current_seed) {
+    return candidate_size > current_size
+        || (candidate_size == current_size && candidate_seed < current_seed);

 int main(int argc, char** argv) {
+    int provided_thread_level = MPI_THREAD_SINGLE;
+    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided_thread_level);
+    if (provided_thread_level < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI implementation does not provide MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED\n");
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+
+    int rank = 0;
+    int world_size = 1;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &world_size);

Implemented hybrid MPI/OpenMP/CUDA parallelization in:

- [qtclustering.cpp](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/qtclustering_gpt-5.6-luna-xhigh_hybrid_r5/qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp)
- [CMakeLists.txt](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/qtclustering_gpt-5.6-luna-xhigh_hybrid_r5/qtclustering/CMakeLists.txt)

Key points:

- MPI distributes seed candidates across ranks and synchronizes the globally best cluster.
- CUDA batches candidate-cluster growth and preserves deterministic tie-breaking.
- OpenMP handles host initialization, reductions, validation, and statistics.
- CUDA is required and selected per local MPI rank.
- Executable remains `qtclustering`; no new source files or external dependencies were added.
- Clean CUDA build succeeded.
- Correctness validated with one and four MPI ranks; result hash matched the CPU reference:
  `662890d30b186a8d`
- 1000-point runs passed cluster validation with identical MPI results.

+// CUDA uses DBL_MAX as the invalid/ineligible marker.  A valid distance is
+// always strictly below the positive threshold, so this marker is unambiguous.
+__device__ __forceinline__ double deviceDistance(const Point& p1,
+                                                 const Point& p2) {
+    const double dx = p1.x - p2.x;
+    const double dy = p1.y - p2.y;
+    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

+__global__ void initializeNearestKernel(const Point* points,
+                                        const int* seeds,
+                                        const unsigned char* clustered,
+                                        const double threshold,
+                                        const int seed_count,
+                                        const int point_count,
+                                        double* nearest) {
+    const size_t work_item = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x
+                           + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(seed_count) * point_count;
+    if (work_item >= total) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int seed_row = static_cast<int>(work_item / point_count);
+    const int candidate = static_cast<int>(work_item % point_count);
+    const int seed = seeds[seed_row];
+
+    if (candidate == seed || clustered[candidate] != 0) {
+        nearest[work_item] = DBL_MAX;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const double candidate_distance = deviceDistance(points[candidate],
+                                                      points[seed]);
+    nearest[work_item] = candidate_distance < threshold
+                        ? candidate_distance
+                        : DBL_MAX;
+}
+
+// One CUDA block owns one seed row.  The explicit pair comparison preserves
+// the original serial rule: equal distances select the lowest point index.
+__global__ void selectNearestKernel(const double* nearest,
+                                    const double threshold,
+                                    const int seed_count,
+                                    const int point_count,
+                                    int* selected,
+                                    int* cardinalities,
+                                    int* active_count) {
+    __shared__ double best_distances[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+    __shared__ int best_indices[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    const int seed_row = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x);
+    if (seed_row >= seed_count) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    double best_distance = DBL_MAX;
+    int best_index = INT_MAX;
+    const size_t row_offset = static_cast<size_t>(seed_row) * point_count;
+
+    for (int candidate = threadIdx.x;
+         candidate < point_count;
+         candidate += blockDim.x) {
+        const double candidate_distance = nearest[row_offset + candidate];
+        if (candidate_distance < DBL_MAX && candidate_distance < threshold
+            && (candidate_distance < best_distance
+                || (candidate_distance == best_distance
+                    && candidate < best_index))) {
+            best_distance = candidate_distance;
+            best_index = candidate;
+        }
+    }
+
+    best_distances[threadIdx.x] = best_distance;
+    best_indices[threadIdx.x] = best_index;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            const double other_distance = best_distances[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            const int other_index = best_indices[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (other_distance < best_distances[threadIdx.x]
+                || (other_distance == best_distances[threadIdx.x]
+                    && other_index < best_indices[threadIdx.x])) {
+                best_distances[threadIdx.x] = other_distance;
+                best_indices[threadIdx.x] = other_index;
+            }
         }
-        
-        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best
-        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {
-            min_diameter = max_dist;
-            closest_point = candidate;
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        const int chosen = (best_indices[0] == INT_MAX)
+                         ? -1
+                         : best_indices[0];
+        selected[seed_row] = chosen;
+        if (chosen >= 0) {
+            ++cardinalities[seed_row];
+            atomicAdd(active_count, 1);
         }

-    return closest_point;
